02

Rental details

Make it fit the job.

Gate totals update as you add or remove gates on the drawing. You can increase these totals for gates you have not placed yet. To remove a drawn gate, choose “Remove gate” and click its marker. Gate markers do not subtract footage; Richard will confirm opening sizes and final measurements.

Rates cover the rental term, not a monthly charge. Distance is self-reported until maps are connected. Richard confirms service coverage and all final pricing.

Additional equipment & site conditions

One sandbag per stand and standard panel gates are included in panel rates. Additional windscreen ballast must be confirmed. Specialty heights, extra-large gates, prevailing-wage work, and modifications require a custom quote.

Windscreen is purchased and stays yours after fence removal. Richard will confirm fence height, gates, access, and scheduling.
